'''2011 German National Championship Benjamin Jakob DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Benjamin Jakob]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Watto: White Slavery Done Right (after Hunter)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
